本文件直接使用 Lab 2 保存的 RDS。Lab 4 的六项任务和截图中的四项任务分开执行。
价格单位按课程材料为英镑。每个代码块可以单独运行，也可以点击 Knit 生成 HTML。

## 1. 读取已经清洗的数据

预期：13,647 行，10 列。价格范围 25–1,000，浴室数范围 0–5。

```{r}
# Updated: uses the supplied cleaned RDS rather than reconstructing from CSV.
# Run once if needed: install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
# Read the dataset already cleaned in Lab 2.
listings_clean <- readRDS(
  "listings_clean.rds"
)
glimpse(listings_clean)
colSums(is.na(listings_clean))
range(listings_clean$price)
range(listings_clean$bathrooms)
count(listings_clean, room_type)

```

## 2. Lab 4：六项探索性分析练习

```{r}

p1 <- ggplot(listings_clean, aes(room_type, price)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "Room type", y = "Price (£)") + theme_minimal()
print(p1)
print(p1 + scale_y_log10())
print(ggplot(listings_clean, aes(bedrooms)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5))
p2 <- listings_clean |> filter(!is.na(bedrooms)) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(bedrooms))) + geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Bedrooms", y = "Listings") + theme_minimal()
print(p2)
print(count(listings_clean, bedrooms))
p3 <- listings_clean |> drop_na(review_scores_rating) |>
  ggplot(aes(review_scores_rating, price)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Average review score", y = "Price (£)") + theme_minimal()
print(p3)
p4 <- ggplot(listings_clean, aes(fct_rev(fct_infreq(property_type)))) +
  geom_bar() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Property type", y = "Listings") + theme_minimal()
print(p4)
top10_neighb <- listings_clean |> count(neighbourhood_cleansed, name = "Count") |>
  arrange(desc(Count), neighbourhood_cleansed) |> slice_head(n = 10)
print(top10_neighb)
p6 <- ggplot(top10_neighb, aes(fct_reorder(neighbourhood_cleansed, Count), Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "skyblue") + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Listings", title = "Top 10 neighbourhoods") + theme_minimal()
print(p6)

```

## 3. 课堂截图：两类房源价格比较

```{r}

listings_no_shared <- listings_clean |>
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> droplevels()
print(count(listings_no_shared, room_type))
p_tutorial <- ggplot(listings_no_shared, aes(room_type, price)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "Room type", y = "Price (£)") + theme_minimal()
print(p_tutorial)
price_summary <- listings_no_shared |> group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_price = mean(price), sd_price = sd(price),
            median_price = median(price), .groups = "drop")
print(price_summary)
price_test <- t.test(price ~ room_type, data = listings_no_shared)
print(price_test)

```

## 5. 对照结果

排除共享房间后共 13,578 条。整套房 8,677 条，均价 £142.58，标准差 £155.85。
独立房间 4,901 条，均价 £61.23，标准差 £78.32。
Welch t 检验 t = 40.419，df 约 13,419，p < 2.2e-16。
整套房减独立房间的平均价差约 £81.35，95% 置信区间为 £77.40–£85.29。
这是筛选后样本的未调整比较，不能解释为因果效应。
